SVRGSP

The National Weather Service in Greenville-Spartanburg has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
South central Greenville County in Upstate South Carolina...
Eastern Anderson County in Upstate South Carolina...
North central Abbeville County in Upstate South Carolina...

* Until 1030 PM EDT.

* At 928 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 12 miles northeast
of Anderson, or near Williamston, moving south at 20 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to trees and power lines.

* Locations impacted include...
Homeland Park, Belton,
